steps.code: bun add -g omo-ai · npm i -g omo-ai

steps.en: Ships the omo TUI with delegation categories, skills, and memory wired in
steps.zh: 带来 omo TUI，内置任务分类路由、技能与记忆系统

steps.en: Start it in your project and sign in to your subscriptions
steps.zh: 在项目里启动并登录已有订阅

steps.en: Stores provider logins and maps each task category to a model fallback chain
steps.zh: 保存登录态，把每类任务映射到一条模型回退链

steps.en: Describe the job and escalate it with a keyword
steps.zh: 描述任务，用一个关键词升级处理

steps.en: Explores, plans in a notepad, and spawns one worker per sub-task by category
steps.zh: 先摸清代码库，在记事本里做计划，按分类派发子任务

steps.en: Verifies each result before it counts as done; durable notes persist for the next session
steps.zh: 结果先过校验才算完成，沉淀的笔记留到下个会话

value.en: You hand over whole jobs instead of prompts: work fans out across models, gets verified before it counts as done, and memory carries into the next session
value.zh: 你交出去的是整个任务而不只是一句提示：工作分摊到多个模型、验证通过才算完成、记忆还能带到下个会话

sources: README.md Install + Why OmO (bun add -g omo-ai; npm i -g omo-ai; omo; /login covers Claude, ChatGPT, Kimi and GLM subscriptions; add ultrawork or ulw to your prompt; type mass ulw and the whole job becomes a graph of agents, each part runs on the model that fits it and gets checked before anything is called done)

docs/guide/orchestration.md (keyword-detector hook activates ultrawork/ulw from message keywords; task(category=...) routes to a category worker; /ulw-execute verifies each checkbox with five gates before it flips to done; boulder.json resumes work across sessions; Kibitzer memory nudges)
docs/reference/features.md (builtin categories quick/ultrabrain/deep-low/visual-engineering/writing with model fallback chains; main agent delegates through the task tool)
docs/reference/configuration.md (memory on by default as a git repository; reflection writes durable notes; telemetry defaults and opt-outs)
